send_as.description: Whose token to authenticate this action with. Prefer 'User' (xoxp-, the default): it posts as the person who connected Slack, who is already a member of their channels. 'Bot' (xoxb-) posts as the workspace app, which fails with 'not_in_channel' unless the app was explicitly invited to the target channel — common when a new user tries the product before adding the app. Only choose 'Bot' when the message must appear from the app AND you know it's a member of the channel.
